additionalUpdate.question: Which body conducts elections to Parliament and State Legislatures?
additionalUpdate.explanation:
Correct answer: Election Commission of India.
Key points: Article 324 vests the superintendence, direction and control of elections to Parliament, State Legislatures, and the offices of President and Vice-President in the Election Commission of India, subject to the Constitution and election laws.
Why the other options are incorrect: UPSC conducts recruitment examinations for specified public services; the Finance Commission recommends fiscal devolution; the CAG audits public accounts. None is the constitutional election-management body.
Exam takeaway: Election Commission = Article 324; UPSC = Article 315; Finance Commission = Article 280; CAG = Article 148.
Source: https://www.legislative.gov.in/static/uploads/2025/07/359f70a69695affb9d72f8393102bd2e.pdf
